## Summary
This PR adds an optional final comments step to the preset `/review` flow, so users can provide extra review guidance before submission.

## UX behavior
- Selecting a preset review target now opens a text prompt for optional extra comments.
- Submitting an empty value proceeds with the review unchanged.
- Submitting non-empty text appends an additional instruction block to the resolved review prompt.
- Pressing `Esc` on the optional-comments step returns to the previous picker (instead of canceling review entirely).

## Implementation details
- Added `additional_instructions: Option<String>` to `ReviewRequest` and propagated it through protocol/core/app-server/exec paths.
- Updated core prompt resolution to trim and conditionally append an `Additional review instructions:` section.
- Updated TUI `/review` preset flow to insert an optional comments prompt before dispatching `Op::Review`.
- Extended `CustomPromptView` with `allow_empty_submit` so this step can remain optional while preserving existing stricter prompt behaviors.
- Regenerated app-server protocol schema/type artifacts to include the new request field.

## Tests
- Added unit coverage in core for:
  - appending trimmed additional instructions
  - ignoring blank additional instructions
- Added TUI flow tests for:
  - opening optional-comments after selecting a review target
  - empty submit sending no additional instructions
  - non-empty submit sending additional instructions
  - `Esc` returning to the previous picker, then dismissing on next `Esc`

## Validation run
- `just fmt`
- `just fix -p codex-tui -p codex-core -p codex-exec -p codex-app-server -p codex-protocol`
- `cargo test -p codex-tui`
- `cargo test -p codex-protocol`
- `cargo test -p codex-core review_prompts::tests`
- `cargo insta pending-snapshots` (no pending snapshots)

## Commits
1. `protocol/core: add optional review additional instructions`
2. `tui: add optional comments step to preset /review flow`


## Related issue
Closes #7825
items.title: tui: add optional end-of-flow comments to /review presets

Problem
- Some clients can end up with threads that have a `conversationId` but no usable `rolloutPath` (e.g. partial thread creation failures). In that state, `archiveConversation` fails and the thread cannot be archived from the UI.

Fix
- Make `ArchiveConversationParams.rolloutPath` optional (nullable/omittable).
- In the app-server handler for `archiveConversation`, fall back to resolving the rollout path from disk via `conversationId` when `rolloutPath` is missing or when the provided path fails.
- Regenerate vendored protocol schema fixtures.

Tests
- `cargo test -p codex-app-server-protocol`
- `cargo test -p codex-app-server archive_conversation_without_rollout_path_resolves_by_id`

Related
- Fixes the "stuck threads can't be archived" symptom reported in openai/codex#11902
items.title: fix(app-server): archiveConversation resolves rollout path by conversationId

Fixes an error path where v1 `newConversation`/`resumeConversation`/`forkConversation` can start an ephemeral session (via params.config or profile), which yields no `rolloutPath` and then immediately errors while responding.

Changes:
- Force `ephemeral=false` for v1 conversation start/resume/fork so the v1 API can always return a persisted `rolloutPath`.
- Add an integration test covering the regression (`config: { ephemeral: true }` should not break v1 `newConversation`).

Refs: #11902

## Summary
This PR adds and hardens a Python SDK for Codex app-server v2 under `sdk/python`, moving it to a release-ready baseline.

### Highlights
- Add sync + async clients for app-server JSON-RPC v2 over stdio
- Add fluent conversation abstractions: `Conversation` and `AsyncConversation`
- Add notebook-friendly helpers: `ask_result`, `stream_text`
- Add typed and schema-backed wrappers (`*_typed`, `*_schema`)
- Expand lifecycle/control API coverage (`thread/fork`, `thread/archive`, `thread/unarchive`, `thread/setName`, `turn/steer`)
- Add robust JSON-RPC error mapping and overload retry helpers
- Add fake transport harness + expanded tests + env-gated real integration smokes
- Add release/readiness docs (`CHANGELOG.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md`)
- Add notebook cookbook examples and release rehearsal script
- Harden packaging (exclude local env/build artifacts from sdist/wheel)

## Validation
- `pytest` in `sdk/python` passes
- Build and metadata checks pass (`python -m build`, `twine check dist/*`)
- Real integration smoke tests pass when `RUN_REAL_CODEX_TESTS=1` and `codex` is available

## Notes
- This keeps dict-native APIs stable while adding typed/schema ergonomics as additive helpers.
- Real integration tests remain env-gated by design.
items.title: Python SDK for app-server v2: fluent API, typing, tests, and release polish

## Summary
- Adds a `[shell] default_login` config option (`true`/`false`) so users can control whether shell tool commands run in a login shell (`bash -lc`) or a plain shell (`bash -c`)
- Default remains `true` (no behavior change when the option is absent)
- Per-invocation `login` parameter on tool calls always takes precedence over the config setting
- Fixes the issue where login shells re-source startup scripts and clobber inherited `PATH` in curated environments (e.g., Oracle ADE, Hermit)

### Usage
```toml
# ~/.codex/config.toml
[shell]
default_login = false
```

## Test plan
- [x] Existing `shell_command_handler_respects_explicit_login_flag` test updated and passes
- [x] New test cases verify `None` login with `default_login=true` produces `-lc` and `default_login=false` produces `-c`
- [x] `shell_command_handler_to_exec_params_uses_session_shell_and_turn_context` passes (full TurnContext integration)
- [x] `config_schema_matches_fixture` passes (schema regenerated)
- [x] All 135 config tests pass
- [x] All 58 shell-related tests pass
- [ ] Manual: set `[shell] default_login = false`, launch with custom PATH, verify PATH preserved in shell commands

Fixes #8922

## Summary

Enhance the Codex A2A server with SACP (Symposium ACP) session management, MCP tool integration, and token usage tracking capabilities.

## Changes

### A2A Server (`codex-rs/a2a`)
- Add SACP session lifecycle management for ACP protocol support
- Integrate token usage tracking via bespoke event handling
- Add `agent-client-protocol` dependency for ACP schema types

### MCP Server (`codex-rs/mcp-server`)
- Enhance A2A handler with unified tool discovery from MCP servers
- Add session-aware HTTP transport routing
- Integrate `agent-client-protocol` for ACP notification types

### Dependencies
- Add `agent-client-protocol` crate for ACP schema integration
- Update `Cargo.lock` with new dependency chain

## Motivation

These changes enable Codex to work as an ACP-compatible agent, supporting:
- Real-time token usage monitoring via `thread/tokenUsage/updated` notifications
- Session management for multi-turn conversations
- Unified tool discovery combining native Codex tools with external MCP servers

## Testing

- `cargo check` passes for all modified crates
- Changes are additive and backward-compatible

## Summary
- change the cwd-change prompt (shown when resuming/forking across different directories) so `Ctrl+C`/`Ctrl+D` exits the session instead of implicitly selecting "Use session directory"
- introduce explicit prompt and resolver exit outcomes so this intent is propagated cleanly through both startup resume/fork and in-app `/resume` flows
- add a unit test that verifies `Ctrl+C` exits rather than selecting an option

## Why
Previously, pressing `Ctrl+C` on this prompt silently picked one of the options, which made it hard to abort. This aligns the prompt with the expected quit behavior.

## Testing
- `just fmt` (in `codex-rs`)
- `cargo test -p codex-tui`

## Summary
- refactor `build_settings_update_items` in `core/src/context_manager/updates.rs` to diff persisted `TurnContextItem` values instead of runtime `TurnContext` + extra ambient inputs
- make `TurnContext` and `TurnContextItem` complete for model-visible settings by adding persisted fields for:
  - shell
  - permissions instructions
  - model instructions
  - personality spec
- thread these fields through turn construction, model switching, review thread setup, and turn-context serialization
- update test fixtures and literals that construct `TurnContextItem` across `core`, `tui`, and `app-server`
- remove now-unused `EnvironmentContext` diff helpers that were superseded by item-based diffing

## Why
This is the next incremental step toward the model-visible state design: setting updates can now be computed from previous/current persisted turn state, reducing dependence on ephemeral runtime inputs and making replay/backtracking behavior more deterministic.

## Testing
- `just fmt`
- `cargo test -p codex-protocol`
- `cargo check -p codex-core --lib`
- `cargo test -p codex-core build_settings_update_items_emits_environment_item_for_network_changes`
- `cargo test -p codex-core turn_context_with_model_updates_model_fields`
- `cargo test -p codex-core resume_warning`
- `cargo test -p codex-tui`

## Notes
- Full `cargo test -p codex-core` and `cargo test -p codex-app-server send_message` hit sandbox-related networking/port-binding failures in this environment (wiremock bind permissions), but targeted coverage for touched behavior passed.
